correctness.rationale: Core helper exists with documented exit codes, env-var defaults, allow-list loading, head-SHA before/after fetch checks, and RESULT=/HEAD= output lines. However convergence semantics diverge materially from the task contract: unresolved_thread_count counts all unresolved threads rather than bot-authored actionable threads only; CONVERGED fires when any allow-listed bot has reviewed (bot_reviews > 0) rather than when all participating expected bots are terminal; quiet-window tracking uses poll elapsed counters instead of latest actionable event timestamps despite fetching timelineItems and defining parse_review_state (unused). Usable partial implementation with meaningful contract gaps.

quality.rationale: Script header and shell conventions are clear; docs, README companions, and grep-based checks are wired consistently. Deductions for dead code (is_bot_allowed, parse_review_state never called), log_info/log_error redefined after sourcing logging.sh, fragile jq allow-list embedding via BOT_ALLOWLIST_NORMALIZED string interpolation, and AI_REPO_GUIDE.md replacing the scripts/lib/jq/*.jq table row instead of adding bot-allowlist alongside it.

process.rationale: Diff stays focused on helper, allow-list, tests, checks, and required prompt/doc surfaces; time-based fallback preserved in pr-resolve-all.md and op-issue-workflow.md. Minor doc-sync gap: op-issue-workflow.md Halt-gate still says '2 quiet rounds' while step 4 now references the poll helper settle contract.

reliability.rationale: Bats file and check wiring exist but coverage is thin: three tests skip (SHA_CHANGED, TIMEOUT, machine-readable output), CONVERGED test attempts sleep stub via heredoc piped to run (non-functional pattern), and objective-grade shows bats_poll_helper skipped with no verification transcript in the bundle. Scaffold present; meaningful contract paths largely unexercised.

citations.claim: unresolved_thread_count uses map(select(.isResolved == false)) on all reviewThreads, not filtered to bot-authored threads
CONVERGED condition is bot_reviews > 0 && unresolved_thread_count == 0, not all participating expected bots terminal
Quiet window uses elapsed poll counter (last_event_time=$elapsed) rather than submittedAt/createdAt from GitHub events; timelineItems queried but unused
parse_review_state and is_bot_allowed are defined but never invoked in the polling loop
